# sailpoint_role_dimension (Resource)

Resource for a dimension of a SailPoint dynamic role. The role must be dimensional (`dimensional = true`). A dimension grants its access profiles and entitlements to the identities that match its membership criteria. Only changed fields are patched. Import with `<role_id>/<dimension_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The role must be dimensional (dimensional = true).

# Minimal dimension
resource "sailpoint_role_dimension" "basic" {
  role_id = "REPLACE_WITH_DIMENSIONAL_ROLE_ID"
  name    = "Engineering - Paris"
  owner = {
    type = "IDENTITY"
    id   = "REPLACE_WITH_OWNER_IDENTITY_ID"
  }
}

# Dimension with access profiles and STANDARD criteria-based membership
resource "sailpoint_role_dimension" "london" {
  role_id     = "REPLACE_WITH_DIMENSIONAL_ROLE_ID"
  name        = "Engineering - London"
  description = "Engineering access for the London office"
  owner = {
    type = "IDENTITY"
    id   = "REPLACE_WITH_OWNER_IDENTITY_ID"
  }
  access_profiles = [
    { type = "ACCESS_PROFILE", id = "REPLACE_WITH_ACCESS_PROFILE_ID_1" },
    { type = "ACCESS_PROFILE", id = "REPLACE_WITH_ACCESS_PROFILE_ID_2" },
  ]
  membership = {
    type = "STANDARD"
    criteria = {
      operation = "AND"
      children = [
        {
          operation = "EQUALS"
          key = {
            type     = "IDENTITY"
            property = "attribute.department"
          }
          string_value = "Engineering"
        },
        {
          operation = "EQUALS"
          key = {
            type     = "IDENTITY"
            property = "attribute.location"
          }
          string_value = "London"
        },
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the dimension (max 128 chars).
- `role_id` (String) ID of the dimensional role the dimension belongs to. Changing it forces a new dimension.

### Optional

- `access_profiles` (Attributes Set) Access profiles the dimension grants. This is a set matched by `id`, so the order SailPoint returns them in does not matter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_profiles))
- `description` (String) Description (max 2000 chars).
- `entitlements` (Attributes Set) Entitlements the dimension grants. This is a set matched by `id`, so the order SailPoint returns them in does not matter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements))
- `membership` (Attributes) Dimension membership rules. Only `type = STANDARD` with `criteria` is supported. Saving the dimension in the SailPoint UI can clear its membership; the next apply restores it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--membership))
- `owner` (Attributes) The owner of the dimension. Typically `type = IDENTITY`. SailPoint stores an owner name only when one is sent, and the provider sends only `type` and `id`, so `owner.name` stays empty for dimensions created through the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the dimension.
- `modified` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# Import format: <role_id>/<dimension_id>
terraform import sailpoint_role_dimension.london "REPLACE_WITH_DIMENSIONAL_ROLE_ID/REPLACE_WITH_DIMENSION_ID"
```
